column_description: Unique identifier for each team member.
ID of the team the member belongs to. may be NULL.
ID of the user who is a team member. may be NULL.
Role of the team member (e.g., lead designer, designer). always exactly one of 'lead designer', 'designer'. may be NULL.
Date and time the member joined the team. may be NULL.
Date and time the member left the team. may be NULL.
